The payment rule

  • The 26th of each Gregorian month, as reported from the HR ministry.
  • Weekends: paid on the next working day (Sunday).

For social security and the Citizen's Account see the monthly payment calendar.

Frequently asked questions

When is the December 2026 allowance paid?

Sunday 27 December 2026, because 26 December is a Saturday so it is paid on the next working day.

Sources

  • Ajel citing the HR ministry — the rehabilitation allowance is paid on the 26th (1 Apr 2024, Arabic)
  • Ajel — paid on the next working day after a weekend (21 Apr 2024, Arabic)
